name: build: J3 heater camera on 802.3af, its page and Mason
setup: const c=window.__e4b; let s=1; for(;s<60;s++){ c.openJob('J3',true,s); if(c.T.v.heat) break; } const J=c.T; J.def.solve(J.v,J.sim).map(a=>JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(a).split('"injector2"').join('"injector"'))).forEach(a=>c.act(a)); for(let i=0;i<4;i++) c.check(); document.querySelector('#devtabs [data-d=camera]').click();
